nodes.label: Multi-Stage Heat Pump Designs (1/2/3 stage)
nodes.rationale: Each fluid is tabulated at one, two and three stages; extra stages mainly raise the achievable COP_max at the same temperature envelope rather than widening the envelope, and steam sink media carry higher COP_min but narrower ranges than water.

nodes.label: Tutorial Slideshow (PDF)
nodes.rationale: Static onboarding slide deck shipped from frontend/public so it is served directly without bundling; content not extracted (4 MB binary).

nodes.label: Frontend HTML App Shell
nodes.rationale: Viewport meta deliberately omits maximum-scale/user-scalable so pinch-zoom stays available for reading dense stream tables on a phone. An inline script strips the 'dark' class on first load to avoid cached dark-mode flicker, and theme-color is pinned to the brand blue #2B589C.

nodes.label: Frontend React + TypeScript + Vite Setup
nodes.rationale: Stock Vite template notes, kept as-is. Records that the React Compiler is deliberately not enabled because of its dev/build performance cost, and documents the optional type-aware ESLint upgrade path.

nodes.label: Embedded Raster Logo/Symbol Graphic
nodes.rationale: 314x148 SVG that is only a wrapper around a base64 JPEG bitmap (714x336, Photoshop/Office export) with clip paths — not true vector artwork, so it will not scale cleanly; used as a report/branding symbol asset in backend data.

nodes.label: Sphinx Docs Toolchain
nodes.rationale: sphinx with myst-parser (Markdown authoring), sphinx-togglebutton (collapsible source blocks), sphinx-book-theme, sphinx-copybutton and sphinxcontrib-mermaid (pipeline flowcharts) — exactly the plugin set the methodology-first, toggle-block docs pattern needs.

nodes.label: Heat Pump Technology Operating Windows
nodes.rationale: Hard sink-temperature and lift limits from manufacturer data define where each technology may be evaluated.

nodes.norm_label: vhthp (hfc/hfo) very high temperature heat pump

nodes.label: Empirical COP Regressions of Prototypical Heat Pumps
nodes.norm_label: empirical cop regressions of prototypical heat pumps

nodes.label: COP Cap of 15.0
nodes.rationale: Prevents mathematically unrealistic COP values when the temperature lift approaches zero.

nodes.label: Prototypical Heat Pump COP Regression
nodes.rationale: Empirical regressions fitted from manufacturer datasets and literature rather than theoretical thermodynamic correlations: COP = a(dT+2c)^b (T_sink+273+c)^d.

nodes.label: Carnot Archetype (half thermodynamic ceiling)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately half the Carnot ceiling, so a real refrigerant scoring above it is expected and not a physics violation.

nodes.label: Theoretical Technology Archetypes in Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Archetypes are swept through the identical mesh as trained refrigerants so published curves can be compared to real machines; COP returns -1 outside the window so the existing COP<=1 filter enforces the envelope without special-casing the loop.

nodes.label: Demand-Limited Heat Pump Integration
nodes.rationale: Duty capped at process demand leaving waste heat unused; excluded with source-limited points from the COP-vs-coverage frontier to avoid dips.

nodes.label: Predictive ML COP Model (scikit-learn regressor via joblib)
nodes.norm_label: predictive ml cop model (scikit-learn regressor via joblib)
nodes.rationale: Trained on a heat pump manufacturer's simulation parameter study, not measurements of operating machines.

nodes.label: Custom COP Formula Evaluation (safe AST)
nodes.rationale: User formulas are compiled to an AST and validated to contain only safe math operators to prevent arbitrary code execution.

nodes.rationale: Deviates from VDI 4646 size-dependent curve and uses integration factor 1.25 not 1.8: VDI factors fit cheap machines; high-temperature HPs cost more per newer sources (DEA 1,550 EUR/kW).

nodes.label: Temperature Shifting by ΔTmin/2
nodes.rationale: After shifting, equal shifted temperatures mean actual temperatures are exactly ΔTmin apart, guaranteeing feasible exchange without pairwise checks.

nodes.rationale: Opposite dTmin/2 shifts make T_sink - T_source equal the true physical lift, so no extra dTmin penalty is applied in COP.

nodes.label: Temperature Shifting by dTmin/2
nodes.rationale: After shifting, hot and cold streams at the same shifted temperature are exactly dTmin apart, guaranteeing feasible exchange without pairwise checks.

nodes.rationale: With heat recovery (default) the heat pump sees only residual pocket-free GCC demand; without, it sees raw full stream duties.

nodes.label: COP Cap at 15.0
nodes.rationale: Prevents unrealistic COP as temperature lift approaches zero.

nodes.label: Theoretical Technology Archetypes
nodes.rationale: Archetypes run through the identical mesh so published curves compare directly with real machines; COP callable returns -1 outside window so the existing COP<=1 filter enforces envelopes without special-casing the loop.

nodes.label: Temperature Pocket Deletion
nodes.rationale: Pockets are heat exchanged internally; removing them yields the pocket-free GCC showing only true external utility before heat pump integration.

nodes.label: HeatTransPlan
nodes.rationale: Finds how much heat can be exchanged internally instead of bought twice (boiler and chiller), and what a heat pump could do with the rest.
